# Rule: process-lifecycle

Fail closed on malformed configuration. Preserve request IDs in logs. Never log payloads or credentials. Child processes inherit cancellation and use the established five-second timeout. Report only observed exit status and elapsed time; a timeout is not successful completion. Version 1 process-sentinel text output is supported.
